House share · Bills included · Furnished ·

Large house share next to Ilford Road Metro Station, close to Jesmond and Gosforth. Double bedrooms available with shared living room, kitchen, bathrooms and sauna. The kitchen and carpets have been recently fitted, and the property has a bathroom and two showers. Included in the rent (£500.00 pcm) is Council Tax, Electric, Gas and Water. Available immediately, contact Acorn Properties on 0191 212 2020 to arrange a viewing.
